purpose: Minimal machine-routing schema for CPR-002 known-unknown registration, CPR-003 autonomous research proposals and CPR-010 evidence-triggered reanalysis. This file defines records only; it does not autonomously promote evidence or validate conclusions.

known_unknowns.closure_rule: RESOLVED_EVIDENCE requires attributable source/test/calculation receipt; SUPERSEDED requires supersession receipt. Never close from analogy or agent confidence alone.

research_proposals.promotion_rule: Proposal priority is explainable and owner-overridable; proposal existence is not validation or engineering acceptance.

reanalysis_events.propagation_rule: Material new evidence identifies downstream conclusions/tasks for reanalysis; prior states remain retained and stale values must not propagate silently.

shared_evidence_controls.raw_record_rule: Raw inputs, code/config, environment, outputs, errors, timestamps and receipts remain distinct from synthesis and are append-only where available.
shared_evidence_controls.null_boundary: INVALID_HARNESS, INVALID_INPUT and MODEL_LIMITATION must not be classified as physical VALID_NULL or concept falsification.
shared_evidence_controls.research_engineering_boundary: R&D findings cannot bypass conventional/certified baseline, physical evidence, professional review, safety or regulatory gates.
shared_evidence_controls.partner_firewall: External organisations remain proposed/candidate until attributable authority evidence exists.

no_go: No silent deletion or replacement of prior/raw states.
No safety/compliance override by information-yield scoring.
